Name: ending_1_empire
name: The Empire Ending
canon: accept the past life as the new identity; become emperor of the empire the past incarnation founded; supplant the descendant; uphold and spread the worship of Ishtar; conquer every land; integrate the barbarians
price: deals with Ishtar asking much of its people in avoiding catastrophe
unlock: standing with the_empire at Oath-bound by Act IV; the player has performed the sacrifice_fish_sea_gems or an Ishtar rite at least once (favour on record); Act IV action: the player accepts the past-life identity at the City of Jewels (or its ruin) and is crowned there — D-018 resolves game-design §11.13 with the parent's standing+Act-IV pattern
source_ref: wb §4.1; endings §3.1; notes L27-29; D-018 (parent pattern per plan.md; endings §2's five kingship requirements)

Name: ending_2_sumerian
name: The Sumerian Ending
canon: support the Prophet; secession; Akkad in ashes; eradicate all Akkadians and Barbarians; spread the old classics; empire covering all of the valley
price: the eradication; and a new hidden evil takes Ishtar's place — an ancient contemporary ruling from behind the scenes as the empire of the bull remains and its cult spreads (identity resolved: Gugalanna, the Bull of Heaven — deities.csv:gugalanna)
unlock: standing with neo_sumerian_rebellion at Oath-bound by Act IV; the player has fought at the Prophet's side in at least one Act III war beat; Act IV action: the player stands with the Prophet at the sack of the City of Jewels — D-018 resolves game-design §11.13
source_ref: endings §3.2; notes L30-32; D-018; the_eight_of_medicine/gugalanna rows resolve the 'empire of the bull' (game-design §11.11's sub-question)

Name: ending_3_barbarian
name: The Barbarian Ending
canon: abandon the river lands; the horde sweeps down like locusts; the Law Maker's and Sumer's legacy finished; poor administration decays the land; no single king — the council of warlords; the gathering of strong individuals
price: the valley's memory rots; the economy stagnates; the farm animals run free
unlock: standing with the_barbarians at Oath-bound by Act IV (or the player has simply abandoned all other standing — the notes' 'abandon the river lands' reads as a non-action as much as an alliance); Act IV action: the player rides east and returns with the horde, taking no crown — a seat on the council of warlords instead — D-018 resolves game-design §11.13

Name: ending_4_brotherhood
name: The Brotherhood of the Serpent Ending
canon: the planned fall of the Empire; the council of warlords rises; Sumer returns for a time only; the Barbarians pushed into the Lost City of Jewels; the Prophet's last rebellion and his summoning defeated by the player and a BotS priest; the right of kingship — a new city on the ruins of Ur with the foundations of the old City of Jewels razed; the final conversation on the age of war and passion
price: the age they open grips man deeper into war and chaos; the Brotherhood takes him elsewhere to cleanse his sins
unlock: hidden — the silent sequence (steps, D-018, see docs/proposals/round-2-invented.md §Hidden Ending): (1) trigger serpent_rumours and follow it without reporting the stranger to any faction; (2) reach favour/standing 40+ with at least two of the three open factions without ever swearing an oath to any of them (the Brotherhood tests neutrality, world-bible §2 — 'worthy enough to stand face to face'); (3) perform the barutu_haruspicy or zisurru_warding rite at purity high at least once (a sign of Sacred-group competence); (4) never commit a death-verdict crime (laws.csv) — the Brotherhood does not recruit the guilty; (5) by Act III's close, decline all three faction Act-IV commitments. Meeting all five opens ending_4 in Act IV with no marker ever shown; missing any one silently closes the path per the parent's silent-sequence pattern
source_ref: endings §3.4-§5; notes L7;L11;L38-39; D-018 (parent template: silent sequence, no markers, one rumour — parent endings §3.4, carried per mechanics.md row 18/25 and endings.md §3.4)
